name: Pro Automation Workflow Builder
description: Zapier-style trigger / condition / action canvas on React Flow: palette drag-in, typed ports with connection validation (type, fan-out, loops), schema-validated step settings, in-house layered auto-layout, minimap, undo/redo, run-state overlay and JSON import/export.

examples.title: Inbound demo routing with test run

props.name: definitions
props.description: Step catalogue: type, kind, ports (outputs typed event/flow/error, inputs list accepted types), fields and optional summarize()

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled workflow; pass the value from onChange back in

props.name: onChange
props.description: After every committed edit (not selection or mid-drag)

props.name: runState
props.description: Per-node queued/running/success/error/skipped overlay with durations and messages

props.name: onRun
props.description: Shows a Test run button, disabled while errors exist

props.name: onImportError
props.description: JSON import was rejected (also shown inline)

usage: Drag steps from the palette (or focus one and press Enter to drop it at the viewport centre). Connections are checked for port type, one edge per output and loops; rejected drops explain why. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo, Delete removes, Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+Shift+L tidies the layout. Imported JSON is validated with zod against workflowJsonSchema and the step catalogue. Auto-layout is a small in-house layered layout (longest-path layering + barycenter sweeps).
